claims.statement: Laurent Freixe was CEO of Nestlé, fired from the role in September 2025 after holding the post for about 12 months.

citations.quote: Freixe, 64, was fired from his role as CEO in September last year, following “an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate“, having held the post for just 12 months.

claims.statement: Freixe worked at Nestlé for 39 years.

citations.quote: the Swiss multinational where he worked for 39 years

claims.statement: Nestlé dismissed Freixe citing violations of the company's code of conduct, specifically an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate, and denied him a severance package.

citations.quote: Nestlé said Freixe would receive no severance package due to “violations of the company’s code of conduct”.

claims.statement: As of June 2026, Freixe is reportedly in pre-litigation settlement talks with Nestlé and has brought the matter before a court, seeking to recover a bonus and unvested shares and arguing the dismissal damaged his reputation and career prospects.

citations.quote: is seeking to recover a bonus and unvested shares following his dismissal from the food and beverage giant, according to Bloomberg reports.
Mr Freixe has brought the matter before the competent court to assert his rights and to obtain redress.

claims.statement: A source close to Freixe says he disputes both the grounds and the manner of his dismissal, claiming he was removed without being heard and stripped of compensation he had legitimately earned.

citations.quote: “Mr Laurent Freixe disputes both the grounds and the manner of his dismissal,” said a source close to him.

claims.statement: Freixe is 64 years old (as of the June 2026 report).

citations.quote: Freixe, 64, was fired from his role as CEO

claims.statement: Laurent Freixe was chief executive of Nestlé until he was fired immediately in September 2025 over an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate.

fact.value: Chief executive of Nestlé until being fired in September 2025

citations.quote: Chief executive Laurent Freixe, who had been at Nestlé for 40 years, was fired immediately due to an “undisclosed romantic relationship” with a direct subordinate, the company said in a statement.

claims.statement: Freixe had been at Nestlé for 40 years before his dismissal.

fact.value: Nestlé (40-year tenure, ended with dismissal in September 2025)

citations.quote: Chief executive Laurent Freixe, who had been at Nestlé for 40 years, was fired immediately

claims.statement: An investigation into the affair found it breached Nestlé's code of business conduct; the investigation was triggered by a report through Nestlé's whistleblowing channel, and Freixe will not receive a payout.

fact.value: Dismissed after an investigation triggered by a whistleblowing report found an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate breached Nestlé's code of business conduct; no payout received

citations.quote: An investigation into the affair found it breached Nestle’s code of business conduct.

claims.statement: Nestlé Chairman Paul Bulcke called the dismissal a necessary decision, citing the company's values and governance.

fact.value: Dismissal publicly endorsed by Nestlé Chairman Paul Bulcke as a necessary decision

citations.quote: “This was a necessary decision,” said Chairman Paul Bulcke. “Nestlé’s values and governance are strong foundations of our company.”

claims.statement: Freixe is replaced as CEO by Philipp Navratil, who has been at Nestlé since 2001.

fact.value: Former Nestlé CEO; succeeded by Philipp Navratil

citations.quote: He will be replaced as CEO by Philipp Navratil, who has been at the company since 2001.

sections.summary: Laurent Freixe was CEO of Nestlé, fired from the role in September 2025 after holding the post for about 12 months. Freixe worked at Nestlé for 39 years. Nestlé dismissed Freixe citing violations of the company's code of conduct, specifically an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate, and denied him a severance package. As of June 2026, Freixe is reportedly in pre-litigation settlement talks with Nestlé and has brought the matter before a court, seeking to recover a bonus and unvested shares and arguing the dismissal damaged his reputation and career prospects. A source close to Freixe says he disputes both the grounds and the manner of his dismissal, claiming he was removed without being heard and stripped of compensation he had legitimately earned. Freixe is 64 years old (as of the June 2026 report). Laurent Freixe was chief executive of Nestlé until he was fired immediately in September 2025 over an undisclosed romantic relationship with a direct subordinate. Freixe had been at Nestlé for 40 years before his dismissal.
